sections.label: Urgency of support measures
sections.summary: The approach is adopted because of the urgency of implementing additional support measures announced in the Deputy Prime Minister's Ministerial Statement on 6 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We adopt this approach because of the urgency of implementing the additional support measures announced in the Deputy Prime Minister's Ministerial Statement on 6 April 2020.

sections.label: President's urgency certification for Bill
sections.summary: The President's certification of urgency was sought and obtained under Standing Order 86 to read the Bill three times in a single Sitting, providing for the Estimates approved in Committee of Supply.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In order to read the Bill three times in a single Parliamentary Sitting, I have sought and obtained the President's certification that the urgency exists for this Bill, under Standing Order 86 of the Standing Orders of the Parliament of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This Bill provides for the Estimates as approved in the Committee of Supply earlier today.
